text:
ashley: heads up — saw a weird churn in eu-west1 this morning. lots of tiny pods not packing, nodes reporting ~0.25 GPU leftover. scheduler logs show a bunch of 'NoMatch' for GPU requests. anyone seen this?

infra-bot: autoscaler: scaled up +6 nodes in eu-west1 at 08:12 UTC (reason: PendingPods).

devin: we recently flipped fractional GPU allocation (0.5 slot) on the gpu-admission plugin. suspect mismatch with node labels + taints. also noticed some pods use preferredDuringScheduling with topologyKey=rack which fragments placement.

mike: can repro locally — podspecs asking for `resources.requests.gpu: 0.5` and the scheduler still treats GPUs as integer in some predicates. looks like the new fractional-slotting path isn't enabled on all schedulers in the fleet.

eva: another signal: InterPodAffinity/TopologySpread is heavily weighted for these jobs, forcing spread across AZs. that prevents binpacking and amplifies fragmentation on nodes with partial free GPUs. dropping spread weight in staging made a big difference.

ashley: quick debug commands i ran: `kubectl get pods -n ml --field-selector=status.phase=Pending` then `kubectl describe pod ml-train-abc` shows bind failure: 
```
I0319 08:20:12 scheduler: pod/ml-train-abc: failed to fit: Insufficient resource: GPU
```

devin: short-term workaround: enable descheduler policy LowNodeUtilization (thresholds tuned) to consolidate fractional pods, but that will evict durante peak — expect a transient spike in evictions.

mike: another mitigation: mark spot nodes with taint `spot=true:PreferNoSchedule` and add tolerations only to short-lived batch jobs. pushes long-running inference/serving onto dedicated nodes so they pack better.

eva: finance note — packing more tightly reduces node count (good), but if we shift across racks/AZs to defragment we might incur more cross-AZ egress. finance asked to estimate impact before a large rebalance. i'll open a quick cost estimate ticket.

ashley: plan: 1) lower topologySpread weight to 0.3 in eu-west1 for ml namespace (canary). 2) flip on fractional-scheduler-plugin on 10% of schedulers (canary). 3) run descheduler job with conservative thresholds overnight. pinging @ops-canary to run step 3.

ops-canary: acknowledged — scheduling descheduler canary for eu-west1 tonight at 02:00 UTC. will post results.

infra-bot: note: keep an eye on preemptions metric (preemptions/sec) and pod evictions, set alert if > 5/min for 15m.

ashley: thanks — i'll monitor and update here. if anyone has logs from affected nodes (node labels: gpu=v100|a100 mismatch) drop them in the thread.
